name: Volumetric Depth Sprite (VDS)
definition: A VDS is an image-based representation of a solid shape's volume, storing depth values along a viewing ray aligned towards the negative z-axis. It extends LDI by containing layers of unique depth complexity, represented as a 3D volume texture.
summary: Volumetric Depth Sprite is an image-based volume representation that enables fast, real-time point-in-volume tests by storing layered depth values in a 3D texture.
